commit.message:
fix(ui): the traced stock casts parallel rays in orthographic view

The sim view's march always cast perspective rays from the eye point,
so in Orthographic mode the traced stock drew with perspective geometry
and slid off the ortho-projected part, meshes and toolpaths.

PreviewCamera grows ortho_half_height (None: the perspective cone) and
one ray law, PreviewCamera::ray: in orthographic each pixel's ray starts
on the eye plane and runs along the view axis - Camera::ray_through's
and Camera::mvp's parallel box. The CPU march, the GPU kernel
(trace.wgsl, half height in world_lo.w) and the composite's hit rebuild
(composite.wgsl, frame.z) all walk it; preview_camera sets it from the
viewport camera's projection, and the frame key carries it so a mode
switch re-marches. Perspective is unchanged.

Fixes #609

fix(ui): vertex-pick visibility follows the parallel view direction in orthographic view

Vertex picking decided a corner's visibility on the segment from the
corner to the camera's eye point. In Orthographic mode the view rays are
parallel, so a corner hidden behind geometry along the view direction
could read as visible, and a visible one as hidden.

sight_origin starts the occlusion ray at the eye in perspective and, in
orthographic, at the corner's own point on the eye plane, so the test
runs back along -view direction exactly as Camera::ray_through casts a
pick; a corner at or behind the eye plane has nothing on screen to test
and is not offered. Perspective is unchanged.

Fixes #610
